aboutMe.headline: From working in a lab to building Edmonton's largest trading community.

cards.title: Humble Beginnings
cards.text: My journey started like many others. I got my first job at 16 years old, working at Ricky's All Day Grill. It taught me the value of hard work early on — a lesson that carried me through my education at NAIT, where I completed the Chemical Technology program. By 22, I landed my first career position as a lab analyst, and by 24, I had advanced to a lab chemist role at Intertek.

cards.title: The Spark
cards.text: On paper, my career was progressing. But I felt a growing desire to build something of my own. While working full time, I began investing in the stock market, starting with ETFs. As I learned more, I discovered trading — and everything changed.

cards.title: The Grind (2020)
cards.text: I quickly realized this wasn't just a side hustle; it was one of the most challenging paths I could've taken, with an average success rate of only 5%. But I was all in. My daily routine for over two years consisted of working 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM, dinner and rest, and studying charts & markets from 7:00 PM – 1:00 AM every single night.

cards.title: The Breakthrough
cards.text: Eventually, the discipline paid off. I achieved consistency, passed prop firm challenges, and proved to myself that trading could be more than just a dream. It became a viable, thriving reality.

cards.title: The Vision for BoomingFX
cards.text: I founded BoomingFX not to sell generic courses, but to build a real physical mentorship framework in downtown Edmonton. An actual community where traders don't trade alone, but learn institutional discipline, risk management, and capital scaling together.

aboutMe.realityText: I don't sell dreams — I teach reality. Trading is not for everyone. If you're looking for a shortcut or a get-rich-quick fix, this isn't it. We are fully transparent, sharing both wins and losses.
aboutMe.quote: "All we ask in return is that you take it seriously. Let's get to work."

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Welcome to BoomingFX! We understand that starting your trading journey can feel overwhelming, so we've put together answers to the most common questions beginners ask.

items.question: HOW MUCH TIME DO I NEED PER DAY TO TRADE?
items.answer: Trading doesn't have to take over your whole day. Many successful members trade part-time around their full-time jobs, school, or other commitments. On average, you may only need 30 to 60 minutes a day to analyze charts, set up trades, and review the market.

items.question: IS THIS BEGINNER-FRIENDLY?
items.answer: Yes, 100%! We start you from scratch — no prior trading experience required. Our comprehensive mentorship breaks down technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and risk management into step-by-step actionable lessons.

items.question: HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED TO START TRADING?
items.answer: You can start learning and practicing with zero capital using a free demo account. Once you're ready to trade with real funds, you can start with a modest balance, or we can guide you through acquiring $50k-$200k+ in funding via prop firm evaluation challenges.

items.question: WHAT MAKES BOOMINGFX DIFFERENT FROM OTHER SERVICES?
items.answer: We operate out of a real physical office in downtown Edmonton and don't just sell recorded courses. We offer daily live mentorship, continuous risk management guidance, in-person workshops, and transparent live trade ideas.

items.question: HOW DO YOUR TRADING SIGNALS WORK?
items.answer: Our expert team analyzes market opportunities daily and delivers verified signals with exact entries, stop-losses, and profit targets directly through Telegram, complete with full technical rationale.

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refundPolicy.subtitle: At BoomingFX, we prioritize transparency, clarity, and professionalism in all our interactions with members.
refundPolicy.p1: At BoomingFX, we prioritize transparency, clarity, and professionalism in all our interactions with members. When you subscribe to BoomingFX, you gain instant access to a range of premium services including daily trading signals, market analysis, educational resources, mentorship, and membership within our exclusive trading community. Because of the immediate delivery of digital content and access to proprietary trading tools and strategies, all subscription payments made to BoomingFX are final and strictly non-refundable.
refundPolicy.p2: We do not offer refunds or partial reimbursements under any circumstances once a payment has been processed. This includes but is not limited to situations where the subscriber has not utilized the services, was unsatisfied with the results, or forgot to cancel prior to the next billing cycle. By subscribing, you acknowledge and agree that BoomingFX is not obligated to provide refunds for any reason.
refundPolicy.p3: However, we understand that individual circumstances change, and you retain complete control over your subscription. You may cancel your subscription at any time by accessing your account settings or by emailing our support team at support@boomingfx.org with your cancellation request before your upcoming billing date.
refundPolicy.p4: Upon cancellation, your recurring payments will stop immediately, and you will not be charged for subsequent billing cycles. You will continue to have full access to all BoomingFX services, signals, educational content, and community features until the end of your current paid billing period.
refundPolicy.p5: We encourage all prospective members to carefully review our services, subscription plans, and terms before purchasing. If you have any questions, need clarification, or require assistance with your account, our support team is available to assist you at support@boomingfx.org.
